APPROVE
The original `if`/`else` path selection, handler check, guard evaluation and ternary are moved unchanged into `ExpressRoute` and `ExpressRouteTarget`, which return null where the loop used to `continue`; that removes roughly 15 complexity points from the loop body at its likely two-level nesting while adding only one `if`, and the nullable-tuple `is not var (…)` deconstruction compiles cleanly. I couldn't find the source file here, so this rests on the diff alone and assumes the helper's `var verb = t[i + 2].Text` matches the loop's existing `verb`.
